name: University College Dublin
summary: Big suburban campus at Belfield in south Dublin: over 130 undergraduate courses, from Commerce and Engineering to Veterinary Medicine, through CAO.

ib.text: Six subjects including English; courses add Maths, a lab science or a third language. Strictest: Actuarial HL Maths 6; Engineering HL Maths 5 and HL science 4; Medicine a third language and HPAT.

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: One common first year across the engineering disciplines, then a free choice of specialisation: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronic, Chemical and Bioprocess, Biomedical and more. Accredited by Engineers Ireland, IChemE and IoM3.
programmes.ib: 33 points with HL Maths 5 and a lab science (Physics, Chemistry or Biology) at HL 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points; UCD may share places out by exam system and rank IB applicants among themselves.

flagshipSource.title: UCD Engineering: seven specialisations after a common first year, accredited by Engineers Ireland, IChemE, IoM3

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine
programmes.about: Five years to become a vet: animal structure, function and welfare first, then disease, medicine and surgery, ending in clinical rotations in the UCD Veterinary Hospital, with 36 weeks of work placements along the way.
programmes.ib: 40 points with Chemistry HL 5 and Maths SL 4 or HL 3; 60 hours of animal-handling experience is also required.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points after you record 60 hours of animal-handling experience with UCD (2026 rule: 2027 dates not yet published).

flagshipSource.title: UCD School of Veterinary Medicine: accredited by VCI, EAEVE and AVMA, with its own Veterinary Hospital

programmes.name: Actuarial and Financial Studies
programmes.about: Mathematics, statistics, economics and finance for a career managing risk in insurance, pensions and investment; year 3 is a professional work placement of at least six months.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points; UCD may share places out by exam system and rank IB applicants among themselves.

flagshipSource.title: UCD Actuarial & Financial Studies: a four-year degree with a professional work placement of at least six months

faculties.name: Arts and Humanities
faculties.line: Humanities (DN530) and Joint Honours (DN520) are multi-subject entries: you apply once and choose subjects within them.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: Four business degrees, from Commerce to Business & Law; pick the one that fits your quantitative or language strengths.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: One common-entry engineering degree, then a free choice of specialisation; HL Maths 5 and a HL lab science 4.

faculties.name: Science, Computer Science and Actuarial & Financial Studies
faculties.line: Science is common entry with streams; Actuarial & Financial Studies asks IB 42 with HL Maths 6.

faculties.name: Health Sciences
faculties.line: Medicine, Radiography, Nursing, Midwifery, Physiotherapy and Sports Science; Medicine adds HPAT-Ireland.

faculties.name: Veterinary Medicine
faculties.line: DN300 asks IB 40, Chemistry HL 5 and 60 hours of recorded animal-handling experience.

faculties.name: Agriculture, Food and Nutrition
faculties.line: Agricultural Science, Food Science, Forestry, Horticulture and Human Nutrition, taught in one School.

faculties.name: Architecture, Planning and Environmental Policy
faculties.line: Architecture, Landscape Architecture and City Planning are taught together in one School.

faculties.name: Law
faculties.line: Law (BCL) alone, or paired with Business, History, Irish, Philosophy, Politics, Economics, Social Justice or French.

faculties.name: Social Sciences
faculties.line: Degrees on how societies work, from justice and sustainable cities to economics and big data.

notes: Irish is part of UCD's entry rule, but you are exempt automatically if you were born outside the island of Ireland, live abroad and present the IB.
Where one exam system dominates a course's applicants, UCD may share its places out by system and rank IB applicants among themselves.
Veterinary Medicine asks for 60 hours of animal-handling experience, recorded with UCD by early July (2026 rule; 2027 dates not yet published).
